identification: Small modern davenport-style writing desk in honey-toned softwood (pine or similar, even orange lacquer), 74 x 54 x 53 cm. Hinged slope with plain red textured insert (looks like felt/vinyl, not tooled leather, no gilt border), pen ledge, frieze drawer with key; slope lifts to a well with two pairs of small pale-timber drawers either side of a slatted letter rack, bright new-looking brass butt hinges. Pedestal with a fielded panel front between turned column pilasters on bun bases; bank of four small drawers with small brass knobs down one side. Construction, shiny uniform finish and hinges say late 20th century reproduction (likely factory or Asian export pine), not Victorian. Estimate 150-200.
